metadata.title: Hadwiger's classification theorem on the sphere via signed orthoscheme decompositions
metadata.abstract: We give an elementary and combinatorial proof of the spherical Hadwiger theorem, which states that every continuous, rotation-invariant valuation on the space of closed convex cones in $\R^n$ is a linear combination of the conic intrinsic volumes. Our proof uses a signed orthoscheme decomposition. Its vanishing step requires only integrability of an orthoscheme restriction of the residual valuation, a weaker regularity condition than continuity.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 以带符号正交单形分解给球面 Hadwiger 定理一个初等组合证明，并在消失步骤把连续性要求减弱到特定限制函数的可积性。
analysis.breakthrough: 简化经典赋值分类定理的证明，并明确某个步骤所需的较弱正则性。
analysis.limitations: 不能将消失步骤的弱假设直接当作整个分类定理都已无需连续性。 数学解读仅依据官方摘要与作者评论，尚未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索与命中核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 凸与积分几何的证明工具简洁，有方法参考价值，略低于曲率及度量主线。
